question_text: Describe how you handle a customer who escalates into aggressive behavior.
expected_answer: You stay calm set boundaries prioritize safety and redirect the conversation professionally

question_text: Explain how you resolve a situation where multiple customers are upset at the same time.
expected_answer: You triage the issues communicate clearly and address each concern in order of urgency

question_text: Describe how you manage a customer who insists on an impossible solution.
expected_answer: You explain limitations offer realistic alternatives and maintain professionalism throughout

question_text: Explain how you handle a customer who accuses you of causing their problem.
expected_answer: You stay composed review the facts and work toward a solution without becoming defensive

question_text: Describe how you respond when a customer threatens to leave negative reviews.
expected_answer: You acknowledge their frustration focus on resolving the issue and aim to restore trust

question_text: Explain how you manage a customer who refuses to follow required procedures.
expected_answer: You explain why the procedure is necessary and guide them through each step patiently

question_text: Describe how you handle a customer who becomes emotional during the interaction.
expected_answer: You show empathy slow the conversation and help them regain clarity before proceeding

question_text: Explain how you resolve a conflict between two customers.
expected_answer: You listen to both sides remain neutral and guide them toward a fair and calm resolution

question_text: Describe how you handle a customer who repeatedly returns with the same issue.
expected_answer: You investigate the root cause implement a lasting fix and follow up to ensure success

question_text: Explain how you manage a customer who challenges your expertise.
expected_answer: You remain confident provide clear evidence based information and maintain a respectful tone
